title: Kiya Bataon Darbar Main Zainab
body:
Kiya Bataoun Darbaar Main Zainab
Kaise Sadme Utha Ke Ayee Hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo Sanad Leh ke Gaye Thi
Main Us Ke Tukroon Par
Qaid Teri Likha Ke Ayee Hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Bharay Darbaar Main Bhi
Usne Tauqeer Nah Ki
Khatmiye Mursal Ki
Jisne Masnad Hai Sambhali
Jahaan Waloon Ko
Uska Chehra Dekha Ke Ayee Hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaise Batalaoun Tumhay
Main Khari Roti Rahi
Aur Hastay The Sabhi
Har Sitam Jhel Ke Beti
Saqeefa Waloon Main
Main Wilayat Suna Ke Ayee Hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujko Bhulay Ga Nahi
Ke Sitamgaroon Ne
Mera Haq Cheen Liya
De Ke Darbaar Main Khutbe
Main Wahaan Batil Ke
Kaser Saaray Gira Ke Ayee Hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Intha Ho Hi Gaye
Main Gawa Deti Rahi
Aur Woh Jhutla Te Rahe
Kiya Bataoun Tumhe Beti
Main Ghar Main Anay Tak
Kitne Aansoon Baha Ke Ayee Hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Baap Ki Masnad Ka
Haal Dekha To Laga
Dekhli Karbobala
Tera Drabaar Main Jana
Main Apni Ankhoon Main
Meri Beti Sama Ke Ayee Hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Saath Betoon Ko Liye
Jis Ghari Binte Nabi
Ghar Main Pohhnchi Hogi
Kis Tarhaan Bibi Ne Ro Ke
Samar Kaha Hoga
Apna Wirsa Gawa Ke Ayee Hoon
